questions.cardText:
[Archaeology] Which ancient civilization is credited with inventing the wheel?
A. Egyptian
B. Sumerian
C. Greek
Answer: B.
questions.en: Which ancient civilization of Mesopotamia is traditionally credited with inventing the wheel?
questions.de: Welcher antiken Zivilisation Mesopotamiens wird traditionell die Erfindung des Rades zugeschrieben?

timeline.labelEn: Pictographs of wheeled wagons at Uruk, Sumer, among the earliest evidence of the wheel
timeline.labelDe: Piktogramme von Radwagen in Uruk (Sumer), einer der frühesten Belege für das Rad

questions.notes: The wheel's origin is debated: wheeled-vehicle evidence of similar age (c. 3500–3400 BC) also comes from Europe (Bronocice, northern Germany) and the potter's wheel is older in Ukraine; Sumer is the traditional credit, hence 'traditionally credited'.

questions.cardText:
[Finance] How do mutual funds and hedge funds differ in terms of regulation?
A. Mutual funds are more regulated than hedge funds
B. Hedge funds are more regulated than mutual funds
C. They are regulated by different agencies
Answer: A. Warren Buffett made a famous bet that a low-cost S&P 500 index fund would outperform a portfolio of hedge funds over ten years. Buffett won the bet, highlighting the advantage of low-cost, passively managed investments over expensive, actively managed hedge funds.
questions.en: Warren Buffett famously bet that a low-cost S&P 500 index fund would outperform, over ten years, a portfolio of which kind of lightly regulated, actively managed investment funds?
questions.de: Warren Buffett wettete bekanntlich, dass ein kostengünstiger S&P-500-Indexfonds über zehn Jahre ein Portfolio welcher Art von wenig regulierten, aktiv verwalteten Investmentfonds schlagen würde?

timeline.labelEn: Warren Buffett's ten-year bet that an S&P 500 index fund would beat hedge funds; the index fund won
timeline.labelDe: Warren Buffetts zehnjährige Wette, dass ein S&P-500-Indexfonds Hedgefonds schlägt; der Indexfonds gewann

questions.notes: The card's regulation point (mutual funds are more regulated than hedge funds) is confirmed by the Hedge fund article; the open question asks the bet from the explanation, whose answer is the less-regulated fund type. The bet was made in 2007 and ran 2008–2017.
